scenario: LFST.4.4 / RFCS.4.3 — the session header's `session_id` is the run id the integrator gave the engine, or empty if it gave none; the engine generates no identifier of its own. A pyds engine is created with no run id, so get_session_header() reports session_id as the empty string. Pins that nothing is minted: an engine that generated a UUID at create would report a non-empty string and fail this. The clause it pins is LFST.4.4, not the one its id names.
